title: Admissions Open for Session 2026-27
content: Admissions for the upcoming academic session are now open for classes I to IX. Interested parents can collect the forms from the school reception.

title: Half Yearly Examination Schedule
content: The half-yearly examinations for classes VI to XII will commence from September 15, 2026. The detailed schedule has been sent via email.

title: Independence Day Celebrations
content: Flag hoisting ceremony will be held on August 15 at 8:00 AM in the school ground. Attendance is mandatory for all students.

title: Parent-Teacher Meeting (PTM)
content: A PTM is scheduled for July 30, 2026, to discuss the progress of students. Timings: 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

title: Inter-School Debate Competition
content: Students interested in participating in the upcoming debate competition must register their names with their respective class teachers by August 20.
